def: to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully

occurrences.text: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man’s life among you, but of the ship.
Wherefore, sirs, be of good cheer: for I believe God, that it shall be even as it was told me.
Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
